source_tables: Tabella 2.1a (building downwash outlines, report page 10/11) and Figura 2.1c (map of the outlines, page 9/11) of 'Building DownWash e Aggiornamento mappe ricadute' (R001-1670346PPI-V00), integration filed in the MIL05 VIA (ID_VIP 13497)
source_crs: UTM zone 32N on WGS84 (EPSG:32632), as printed ('Coordinate UTM32N - WGS84')
building_identity: Figura 2.1c draws A (main data-hall block) with B along its east side on the main MIL05A lot and C (long block) with D (small block) on the separate south-west lot that the VIA summary calls the MIL05B expansion area; D lies 50 m and C 116 m from A+B.
method: shapely 2.1.1 area centroid of the union of outlines A, B, C and D in EPSG:32632, inverse-projected to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (no datum change)
identity_cross_check: The 50 generator stacks printed in UTM 32N WGS84 in Tabella 4.3b of the March 2025 air-quality study (E1-E50) fall into three rows: E1-E20 lie 17.7-36.8 m north of A+B, E21-E39 lie 17.0-37.4 m south of A+B, and E40-E50 lie 19.1-42.7 m from C+D. The decree describes 50 standby generators; the VIA summary gives 48 MW IT for MIL05A and 12 MW IT for MIL05B.
imagery_check: Qualitative only: in an Esri World Imagery export in EPSG:32632 (esri-stack-mil05-vignate-utm32.jpg) outlines A and B fall on a large cleared plot south of an existing factory complex and east of an industrial estate, C falls on a wooded strip and D on a small existing building on the south-west lot, consistent with the 'planimetria demolizioni MIL05B' of the filing; no systematic offset. The imagery date is not stated and the cleared ground is not used as a status observation.
